answer: Sybil tax burns the cost of fakes. Each new identity pays a non-refundable fee of 10 days' earnings before trading, and the fee is destroyed, not held: no refund, no resale, like an opal crushed at once. A lone fake sits on its own island, unable to share it, and the network checks the pulse of its activity first. Forging 100 identities costs 100 fees, 1,000 days of earnings, while an honest agent pays once and keeps all rewards undiluted.
